name: Multiple Scattering Model (Integral Equation)
aliases: General integral equation for radiation transport
definition: A model accounting for multiple scattering events. It requires finding intensity I(X, ω) at each point X in each direction ω.
summary: The Multiple Scattering Model (Integral Equation) is a deterministic, global formulation of radiative transfer that solves for radiance via a Fredholm integral equation, distinguishing itself from differential or stochastic methods by explicitly accounting for multiple scattering events.
